after_trial.a: To keep using the app, the owner pays {total} a month online (UPI Autopay or card). If the payment does not come, the app keeps working for {grace} more days.

customer_money.a: No. Your customers pay you in cash or UPI, as they do today. The app records the payment and gives a receipt.

customers.a: No. The price is the same for any number of customers.
customers.q: Is there a limit on customers?

data.a: No. Your data is not deleted when you stop paying or cancel.

gst.a: The price is {price} a month. GST at {gst}% is {gst_amount}, so you pay {total}.

not_paid.a: After those {grace} days the app becomes view only. You can see all your data and linemen can still collect money, but new bills are not made until you pay.

collect.activity: When someone signs in or changes something: the time, the internet (IP) address and the browser, so that we know who changed what.
collect.customers: About the operator's customers, as the operator enters them: name, customer code, phone, address, area, connections (VC numbers), plans, bills and payments.
collect.fee: For our monthly fee: the payment is handled by our payment partner, Razorpay. We do not see or keep card numbers.
collect.owner: About the owner and the business: business name, owner's name, mobile number, email and password. Passwords are stored only in a scrambled form that cannot be read back.
collect.phone_app: From the linemen's app: the phone model, Android version and app version, to keep sign-in safe.
collect.team: About staff and linemen: name, user name, and phone number if the owner adds it.

cookies.text: We use cookies to keep you signed in and to remember your language. The bot check on the sign-up page may use them too. We do not use cookies for advertising.

privacy.description: What information Cable Billing keeps, why, and who can see it. Draft for legal review.
privacy.intro: This page says what information Cable Billing keeps, why we keep it, and who can see it.

keep.text: We keep the data while the operator's account exists. It is not deleted when the subscription ends. The period after an account is closed is not decided yet.
keep.title: How long we keep it

operator_data.text: The operator decides which customer details to enter. We keep them for that operator's business. One operator cannot see another operator's data.
operator_data.title: Customer data is the operator's

others.text: Hosting: Vercel. Database: Neon. Email: Resend. Our monthly fee: Razorpay. Bot check on sign-up: Cloudflare Turnstile. Error reports: Sentry. Sign-in limits: Upstash.

requests.text: To ask about your data, to correct it, or to complain, contact us.

safety.text: Connections to the app are encrypted (HTTPS). Passwords are stored scrambled. Each operator's data is kept separate, and changes to money records are recorded.

privacy.title: Privacy policy

who.text: Cable Billing is an app for local cable operators to keep customers, make bills, collect money and give receipts. The operator (the owner of the cable business) signs up and uses it for their business.
who.title: Who we are

account.text: The owner signs up with their own details and checks their email. The owner adds staff and linemen and gives them their sign-in details. Keep passwords secret.
account.title: Your account

cancel.text: The owner can stop the subscription. The app then becomes view only. Your data is not deleted.

changes.text: These terms may change. When they do, the date at the top changes too.

data.text: The customers, bills and payments you enter are your business data. You can see them in the app at any time, also in view only mode.

terms.description: How Cable Billing works: trial, price, view-only mode and your data. Draft for legal review.
terms.intro: These terms explain how Cable Billing works and what to expect when you use it.

messages.text: The app opens WhatsApp or SMS on your phone with the receipt link. We do not send these messages ourselves, so we cannot know if they reached the customer.
messages.title: WhatsApp and SMS

money.text: Your customers pay you in cash or UPI. The app only records these payments; it does not move money.
money.title: Money from your customers

not_paid.text: The app keeps working for {grace} more days. After that it becomes view only: you can see your data and linemen can still collect money, but new bills are not made. When you pay, everything works again. Bills for the months in between are not made by themselves; the owner can make them from Bills.
not_paid.title: If the fee is not paid

price.text: The first {days} days are free. After that the price is {price} a month + GST ({total} a month), for any number of customers. The owner pays online in Settings, App subscription.
price.title: Free trial and price

receipts.text: Receipts from the app are simple payment receipts. They are not GST tax invoices.
receipts.title: Receipts and tax

records.text: A saved payment or bill is never deleted. A mistake is fixed with Undo payment or a Bill change, and both stay on record.
records.title: Payments and bills stay on record

service.text: Cable Billing is an app for local cable operators: customers and connections, monthly bills, money collection by linemen, receipts and reports. The office uses it on the web; linemen use the Android app.
